_comment: Reference fonts the derivation may borrow outlines from. A reference is a pinned, licensed source: the identity, the SHA-256 and the license live here, the tool refuses a file that does not match, and every glyph taken from it is recorded in the build report. tools/prepare_reference.py fetches and verifies the file (release asset first, then a mirror); referencing another font is allowed, shipping one without its licence and provenance is not.

references.coverage: GB2312 simplified Chinese on the Zen Maru skeleton (12,329 codepoints, 3385 of them characters Zen Maru never drew)
references.notes: The maintained build is published as a release asset (ChillRoundM_v1.805.zip); this pin is the extracted ChillRoundM.ttf and is verified by SHA-256 no matter where the copy came from. Earlier ChillRoundM builds shipped blank placeholders for the simplified set, which is why the version and hash matter.
